operative_context: Rent status updates to 'Active' when rental start date is reached or manually activated by authorized users
## 2.4.1 The system shall update the rent status to Active when the rental start date is reached.
Modification is prevented for 'Approved', 'Active', 'Completed', 'Rejected', or 'Cancelled' status unless explicitly permitted
Rent creation requires selection of rentable item, rental start date, and rental end date
System validates that the rentable item is available for the requested rental period
System prevents creation of overlapping rent records for the same rentable item
Authenticated users can create a rent request for an available rentable item
Authorized users can cancel rent records in 'Approved' or 'Active' status
All required fields must be validated before creating the rent request
Rent records are created with status set to 'Requested' upon creation
Activation is prevented for rent records not in 'Approved' status
Rent records can be modified only when status is 'Requested'
Maintenance duration is dynamic and depends on Equipment Category
Upon reaching rental end date, status updates to 'Maintenance'
After maintenance period completes, status transitions to 'Available'
Authorized users can approve or reject rent requests
Users can cancel rent records in 'Requested' status
Rent status updates to 'Approved' when approved, 'Rejected' when rejected
exceptions: Rent records with rental periods in the past may be created if explicitly permitted
Rent records in 'Approved', 'Active', 'Completed', 'Rejected', or 'Cancelled' status may be modified if explicitly permitted
Maintenance duration is category-dependent rather than a fixed value
conflicts_or_obsolete: Older lifecycle notes referenced a single fixed timer for post-rental handling; current specification requires category-dependent handling durations
